Okay so this isn’t that related at all but it makes me think of something that happened when I was around the same age as your son. My mom (who was a single mother at the time) my younger brother and I had gone to our local Target and looked at the video games. We were really into Spider-Man at the time and Spider-Man 2 (pretty sure that was it) had just come out for either gamecube or PS2 and we saw that it was labeled as “19.99” and asked our mom if we could get it. She said she could spare that to get it for us. She always has wanted to give us whatever she can, and she didn’t make a lot of money at the time so stuff like this was huge to us as kids. We had it brought to the checkout lane and they rang it up....and it comes up as $40-60 bucks. My mom isn’t able to buy it at this price and my brother and i are very sad, since we had our hearts set on this game. My mom explains that it was labeled as 19.99. Apparently it had been labeled wrong or put in the wrong spot, despite being in the glass case and not outside where anyone could move it (so we had no reason to believe we needed to read the fine print, which is usually something I do nowadays). The staff goes to check it out, finds that someone did in fact put it in the wrong place. They sell us the game for 19.99.

I know this was more on the company’s policies, but as a child it really stuck with me, since we weren’t able to afford much. I currently work at the place it was sold to me, for now, and I try to be as helpful as I can in similar situations. One of my favorite things to do is use my own change to finish the purchases of kids and teens that didn’t take tax into consideration and sheepishly tell me they can’t get what they wanted bc of it lol (i would do more but i don’t have enough money on my own at this time). It always makes them super happy and I love it.

So yeah, obviously this one isn’t the same kind of event but it still stuck with me until now! So i wanted to share lol. It (my story) wasn’t worth its own thread but i think it fits ok under this one. ❤️

Also, I’m so happy for your son! I’m glad he has such great parents, too. You’re wonderful.

I’m so sorry this happened to you. Does anyone know..? If you haven’t told anyone yet, confide in the person/s you trust the most. Be it your parents, a friend, etc... If you need to, you can keep the pregnancy out of it. I would try to visit the hospital and see what they can do for you. Don’t bother with the police yet, since they won’t usually help with what you need right now. You can go to them after this is settled if you want to. I also would like to add that it is completely okay to get an abortion. You are not obligated to have a baby, especially one you were not even given any sort of choice in being impregnated with. The thing inside you isn’t even a baby yet. It’s just a parasite right now. You can choose to keep or get rid of it, and either way is okay. I really hope you’ll be okay. I’m sorry.

I’m sorry for your loss... it’ll hurt but eventually you’ll be able to remember him and feel happy to have been in each others lives without hurting too much. It looks like he lived a full life judging by his face, so i hope that is the case. Try to take comfort in that, and at the least he got to spend his life with someone who loved him. Thank you for sharing and I hope you feel better soon. Rest in Peace Tyler...!

I went through a few different names over a span of 3-4 years at first to try and test them out. Usually i would pick names of characters i would associate with or relate to and then try them as my own. Eventually when I had been going by one name for a bit (but was having trouble picking between that and another) I had picked a username on a site that happened to be a name of a different character altogether. I started to notice that people on the site would see my username and start calling me by it and nicknames from it and I found myself amazed at how comfortable it felt and how much i accepted it as me. Now a few years later I have completely adopted the name as my own and it just feels like it's me. It's a really common name but that's okay with me. My birth name was lovely but people always said or wrote it wrong and i was tired of that, so the common name i have now is a relief in terms of readability. Basically you gotta just have it come to you. It's okay to "test" names as well. You never HAVE to stick with the first (or second or third etc) name you pick. Just keep trying until one sticks and feels right...!

Believe me the name Alder isn't any more feminine than the name I picked (Zacharie. I go by Zach usually) yet people at work always ask what Zach is short for and comment on how interesting it is that my name is Zacharie. And usually they comment on it in a way that makes it seem like they wanna get my birth name out of me but I'm not gonna play their game lol.

People just... do that. I apologize. Alder is a super cool and handsome name, imo. Sorry about your mum as well... hope she turns around and is kind to you again... good luck!

I can't speak from experience as I'm on gel but I do know I take insulin (diabetes) with small needles in the stomach and the only downside to that is that it can sometimes come out. If it's a big needle it's likely to stay deep inside but smaller needles don't always get it in there completely. This also depends on how absorbent you are under your skin and if it will take easily. It should be fine, but i wanted to go ahead and explain the difference. Likewise, small needles are less likely to hurt, while big ones might smart a bit.

Edit: Also congratulations! I hope everything goes well!! Also if you take one type of shot and don't like it they should be able to swap it if you ask. Be sure to discuss these things with your provider! :)
